python-sqlite-params:
import sqlite3
def count_name(name):
    db=sqlite3.connect(":memory:")
    try:
        db.execute("CREATE TABLE people(name TEXT)")
        db.executemany("INSERT INTO people VALUES (?)",[("Ada",),("O'Neil",)])
        return db.execute("SELECT count(*) FROM people WHERE name=?",(name,)).fetchone()[0]
    finally:
        db.close()
